steps.run: printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 101\n' >/usr/sbin/policy-rc.d && chmod +x /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d && apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git gh wget zip unzip xz-utils jq ripgrep sudo less procps openssh-client gnupg tzdata build-essential pkg-config make cmake ninja-build python3 python3-dev python3-pip python3-venv sqlite3 poppler-utils qpdf postgresql-16 postgresql-client-16 redis-server && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
echo 'dash dash/sh boolean false' | debconf-set-selections && ln -sf bash /bin/sh && [ "$(readlink -f /bin/sh)" = /usr/bin/bash ]

curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --exclude='*/CHANGELOG.md' --exclude='*/LICENSE' --exclude='*/README.md' && npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit pnpm yarn && npm cache clean --force
pip install --no-cache-dir uv numpy pandas matplotlib openpyxl python-docx python-pptx pypdf playwright

set -ex; [ "$(readlink -f /bin/sh)" = /usr/bin/bash ]; python3 --version; pip --version; uv --version; node --version; npm --version; pnpm --version; yarn --version; go version; gcc --version | head -1; cmake --version | head -1; ninja --version; git --version; gh --version | head -1; jq --version; yq --version; rg --version | head -1; sqlite3 --version; psql --version; pg_lsclusters; redis-server --version; pdftotext -v 2>&1 | head -1; qpdf --version | head -1; command -v setsid; python3 -c 'import numpy, pandas, matplotlib, openpyxl, docx, pptx, pypdf, playwright'; python3 -c 'from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    p.chromium.launch().close()'
